devon: Heads-up — noticed a clear tail increase on token latency for routes hitting the gpt-j-6B-quant pool starting ~08:10 UTC. SM occupancy jumps to ~92% and KV cache miss-rate spikes at the same time. dashboard: https://grafana/rdw/d/perf/route-token-waterfall :eyes:

alex: I saw that too. Kernel selector is falling back from the quantized CUDA kernel to the fp16 path when a few batches trigger KV eviction. Profiling snippet I grabbed:```promql
sum(rate(gpu_sm_occupancy_total[1m])) by (instance)
sum(rate(kvcache_miss_total[1m])) by (route)
sum(rate(kernel_fallbacks_total[1m])) by (kernel_type)
```

maria: Current KV sampling is 0.5% on that pool — we probably under-sample the bursty routes. If misses are correlated with a hot prefix, we miss prefetch opportunities. Suggest bump to 5-10% for routes /chat-stream and /summarize.

sam: I added a quick panel: "per-route token-latency waterfall + SM overlay" (panel id 719). It shows the tail aligning with GPU power spikes on node-03. Link: https://grafana/rdw/d/719/route-latency-waterfall

alex: Also saw VRAM alloc failures metric tick during the same window: `vram_alloc_fail_count{instance="node-03"}`. Thermal sensors show a small temp rise ~3C before the drop in perf — could be thermal throttling + MIG slice imbalance.

perf-eng: When kernel fallback happens we often see head-of-line delays from the dynamic batcher: fallback reduces kernel throughput -> batch queue grows -> latency tail. Two quick experiments: 1) reduce max_batch_delay from 15ms to 8ms for that pool, 2) enable adaptive_batch_weight to favor smaller batches under high SM occupancy.

devon: Action items I'm taking: 1) open PR to increase KV sampling for the heavy routes to 7% (to validate prefetch), 2) add a Grafana timeseries for `kernel_fallback_rate` and overlay with `kvcache_miss_rate`, 3) schedule a microprofiling run with perf markers on node-03 to collect kernel timelines. I'll also add a panel for MIG-slice-utilization skew.

maria: I'll add an alert rule: p99_token_latency > 150ms for /chat-stream for 5m and a runbook link. Also will add an annotation when we flip KV sampling so we can compare. :+1:

perf-eng: For the MIG skew query try:```promql
max_over_time(gpu_mig_slice_utilization[5m]) - min_over_time(gpu_mig_slice_utilization[5m])
```If > 20% that's a red flag. Also add `vram_page_faults_total` to the dashboard to catch swap-like behavior.

infra-bot: deploy:infra/kv-sampling-bump finished — canary started on pool-gpt-j-6B-quant (sha: a1b2c3)

devon: Nice. After the canary runs for 30m let's reconvene. If tail improves, we'll roll to all nodes. If not, we try the batcher param changes and the prefetch increase.

alex: One more note — the kernel selector logs show increased `small_token_path` usage for some requests, meaning sequence-length distribution changed during the burst. Could be client-side prompt changes. I'll correlate with request payload size histograms.

sam: Setting up a short 15m sync at 09:00 UTC to review canary metrics and decide next step. Invite sent. :calendar:

devon: Thanks all — will post the profiling artifacts and PR links in this thread when ready. :memo:
